geometries.query: SELECT count(*) AS total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE ST_IsValid(geom)) AS valid,min(ST_SRID(geom)) AS min_srid,max(ST_SRID(geom)) AS max_srid FROM public."Kommunale Gebiete Deutschland"

attributes.query: SELECT source,indikator,zeitbezug,count(*) AS rows FROM public.dashboard_data_de GROUP BY source,indikator,zeitbezug ORDER BY source

joined.query: SELECT count(*) AS total,count(g.id) AS matched FROM public.dashboard_data_de d LEFT JOIN public."Kommunale Gebiete Deutschland" g ON g.nationalco=d.kennziffer

example.query: SELECT g.nationalco,g.name,d.indikator,d.zeitbezug,d.wert,d.source FROM public.dashboard_data_de d JOIN public."Kommunale Gebiete Deutschland" g ON g.nationalco=d.kennziffer WHERE g.nationalco='12051000' ORDER BY d.source
